plan: With a private value of $20, I want to bid strategically. Since values are uniformly drawn between $0-$49, the expected value for other bidders is $24.50. Rational bidders will likely bid below their value to maximize profit. I'll aim to bid slightly above my value but not too high. A bid around $25-$30 seems reasonable - high enough to have a good chance of winning, but not so high that I risk negative earnings if I win.

A reasonable strategy is to bid slightly below my true value, around $25-$28, hoping to win if others bid conservatively. This allows potential profit if I win while protecting against overpaying. I'll aim to bid $27 to balance winning probability and profit margin.
